name: AWS EKS Cluster
description: Provisions AWS VPC, IAM, and an EKS cluster with optional high-performance nodes for BNK. Use this first, then deploy BNK Platform on top.
outcomes: VPC with public and private subnets across two AZs
EKS cluster with configurable node count and instance type
IAM roles for EKS cluster and worker nodes
Optional EBS CSI driver for persistent storage
Optional high-performance nodes with SR-IOV for BNK

modules.name: High-Performance Nodes
modules.description: DPDK/SR-IOV enabled nodes for BNK TMM and control plane workloads

name: AWS EKS Cluster - Demo
description: Streamlined AWS EKS cluster for fast demos — VPC + IAM + EKS only. Skips storage and high-performance nodes. One click and you have a working cluster in ~12-15 minutes.
outcomes: VPC with public + private subnets across two AZs
Jumphost EC2 with SSH key + Elastic IP
EKS cluster with t3.large worker nodes
IAM roles + OIDC provider ready for service accounts

user_ip.label: Your Public IP /32
user_ip.description: Your public IP in CIDR /32 form, used to whitelist SSH (jumphost) + EKS API access. Find your IP at https://checkip.amazonaws.com then append /32.

name: GenAI Gateway Solution
description: Deploys demo applications, gateway/routes, security policies, observability, and optional AI proxy/analyzer components on top of an existing BNK platform.
outcomes: BNK Gateway with standard-http and smart-http listeners
LiteLLM OpenAI-compatible proxy to AWS Bedrock (multi-model)
SmartLLM iRule for prompt classification and weighted routing
Token counting HSL telemetry with Fluent Bit to Loki pipeline
Firewall policies with address/port lists attached to Gateway
AI Intelligent Load Balancer analyzing Prometheus metrics
Traffic generators for validation and benchmarking

modules.name: Demo Namespaces
modules.description: Creates demo-apps, bnk-gw, observability namespaces with ReferenceGrants for cross-namespace routing

modules.name: Demo Applications
modules.description: Deploys web frontend (nginx), echo API service, and backend service — lightweight containers for traffic routing demos

modules.name: Observability Stack
modules.description: Deploys Fluent Bit (HSL UDP :5514) and Loki — receives token usage telemetry from BNK iRules

modules.name: Demo Gateway
modules.description: BNK Gateway with static VIP (10.0.10.100), standard-http (:80) and smart-http (:8080) listeners

modules.name: Demo Routes
modules.description: HTTPRoutes: standard-http (:80) → demo-web:80, smart-http (:8080) → litellm-proxy:4000

modules.name: Demo Security Policies
modules.description: F5BigFwPolicy with allow/deny rules, address/port lists, and BNKSecPolicy attached to Gateway

modules.name: Demo iRules & Network Policy
modules.description: Token counting HSL iRule + SmartLLM routing iRule (prompt classification, weighted complexity, per-user quota). BNKNetPolicies bind iRules to Gateway listeners.

modules.name: Traffic Generators
modules.description: CronJob-based internal health checks — curl loops to backend services directly (real traffic testing via jumphost)

modules.name: AI LLM Proxy (Bedrock)
modules.description: LiteLLM OpenAI-compatible proxy to AWS Bedrock (Claude Sonnet smart-model + Nova Micro fast-model). Uses IRSA for auth. Includes Prometheus metrics + AI HTTPRoute on smart-http listener.

modules.name: AI Intelligent Load Balancer
modules.description: F5BigAnalyzer CR with custom Bedrock script — reads LiteLLM Prometheus metrics to dynamically adjust model weights

prerequisites.description: Kubernetes cluster with BNK already deployed

prerequisites.name: bnk-on-k8s
prerequisites.description: BNK platform stack must already be deployed — typically F5 BNK 2.2 Platform on Existing Kubernetes, and conceptually any equivalent BNK platform deployment that provides GatewayClass, FLO, CNEInstance, and VLANs

name: Intelligent AI Load Balancing Demo
description: 3-model Bedrock backend behind a BNK Gateway with F5BigAnalyzer for live traffic-weighted routing. Includes a load generator so weight shifts are visible in real time. Requires BNK 2.2 platform deployed.
estimated_cost: Pay-per-use Bedrock (~$0.035/M input tokens on Nova Micro)
outcomes: 3 single-model Bedrock shim pods (Nova Micro, Nova Lite, Claude 3 Haiku) behind a BNK Gateway
HTTPRoute with 3 weighted backendRefs — analyzer mutates weights live
F5BigAnalyzer CR (Path A builtin LLMLoadMonitor) reading Prometheus
vllm:* backend metrics + smartllm_client_* client metrics in Prometheus
Poisson-paced client sending varied prompts from a ConfigMap prompt bank
Dashboard Traffic Distribution tile shifts live as the analyzer weights

modules.name: Bedrock IAM Role (IRSA)
modules.description: Creates the IAM role the backend shim pods assume via IRSA to call Bedrock (Nova Micro, Nova Lite, Claude 3 Haiku). role_name auto-derives from project name to avoid shared-account collisions. Output role_arn auto-wires into the backend module.

modules.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Backend
modules.description: 3 Bedrock shim pods + BNK Gateway + HTTPRoute + F5BigAnalyzer CR, deployed in default namespace by default. bedrock_role_arn auto-wires from the IRSA module output.

modules.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Client
modules.description: Poisson-paced load generator sending varied prompts to the Gateway VIP from a separate namespace

prerequisites.description: EKS cluster with the OIDC provider enabled (required for IRSA)

prerequisites.name: bnk-on-k8s
prerequisites.description: BNK platform deployed — must have bnk-gatewayclass + programmed external VLAN with a free VIP

prerequisites.name: kube-prometheus-stack
prerequisites.description: Prometheus operator installed. ServiceMonitors use label release: kube-prometheus-stack by default — override prometheus_release_label on both modules if different.
AWS account with Bedrock model access granted for Nova Micro, Nova Lite, and Claude 3 Haiku in the target region. Pre-check per region — Nova and Haiku availability varies.

name: BNK 2.2 Platform (AWS)
description: Deploys F5 BNK 2.2 on AWS EKS with optimized defaults — host-device CNI, gp3 storage, ENI secondary IP assignment. Battle-tested and production-ready. Requires jwt_token and cne_pull_secret.
outcomes: F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) managing all BNK components
TMM data-plane with full BNK component suite
Jetstack cert-manager installed with BNK-compatible TLS prerequisites
Multus NADs configured for raw L2 data-plane attachment (no NAD IPAM)
F5SPKVlan CRs with custom self-IPs and subnets
GatewayClass ready for Gateway API routing

modules.name: BNK Prerequisites
modules.description: Creates namespaces (f5-operator, f5-utils, bnk-gw), FAR pull secrets

modules.name: Network Attachments
modules.description: Creates Multus NADs for TMM data-plane interfaces. Raw L2 NAD model only (no NAD IPAM). Set CNI type and SR-IOV resource names for your cluster.

modules.name: Cert Manager
modules.description: Installs Jetstack cert-manager for BNK TLS prerequisites only. Issuer/CA resources are managed by the dedicated Forge manifest module.

modules.name: BNK Cert Issuer
modules.description: Creates the Forge-managed cert-manager issuer chain (self-signed ClusterIssuer, BNK CA certificate/secret, and bnk-ca-cluster-issuer).

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Deploys FLO via Helm with CPCL key and license activation

modules.name: CNE Instance
modules.description: Creates CNEInstance CR — triggers FLO to deploy TMM and all BNK components

modules.name: BNK VLANs
modules.description: Creates F5SPKVlan CRs — sets TMM self-IPs on data-plane interfaces. Prefix lengths are configured directly; NAD CIDR/IPAM is not used in this flow.

modules.name: BNK GatewayClass
modules.description: Creates GatewayClass for BNK (controllerName auto-constructed from FLO namespace)

prerequisites.description: Kubernetes cluster with HugePages, SR-IOV, and Multus CNI configured. Existing-cluster differences (device plugin labels/resource names, CA issuer policy, storage classes) must be aligned for your environment.

prerequisites.name: cne_pull_secret
prerequisites.description: Base64-encoded F5 FAR service account key JSON content (injected into k8s/bnk-prerequisites). Falls back to encrypted System Default if not set in project.
